name: G-node
summary: Gamer-focused low-latency ADSL ISP (free 10pm-7am unmetered, ~2006); defunct.

events.details: The ABR entity G-NODE PTY LTD (ACN 649 898 224, VIC; ABN cancelled 1 Jul 2024) is a later same-name company, over a decade after this gamer ISP's c.2009 end; unrelated.

refs.label: ABR: G-NODE PTY LTD ACN 649 898 224 (unrelated later VIC company, not the gamer ISP)
